main_body: adobe desert building with flat roof terrace and front wall
top_band: light tan roof terrace with parapet walls, rug, and trapdoor across rows 1-31
evidence: Rows 1-31 show a horizontal flat roof terrace from above (with recessed floor at rows 3-27, parapet edges, a red rug, and a hatch), followed by a bright front parapet edge (row 30-31), dark eave shadow (rows 32-33), and the vertical front wall with inset door and window (rows 34-63).

style.evidence: Richly textured adobe plaster with speckle grain, 5+ value steps across the sandstone/adobe ramp, dark brown material-toned outlines, detailed wooden door with hardware, lattice window, beam ends, and roof rug/hatch matching Beodeul building density.
